messages:
alex: quick thread for the presets migration PR — converter bumped a few subtle breakages when moving samples to metrics_v2. listing them here so reviewers have context.
ruhi: drop the PR link when ready, Ill take the external link fix.
dave: what's failing in CI?
ci-bot: examples renderer failed: TypeError: tracehook.trace_key must be str, got NoneType (examples/presets/kv_latency.yaml).
alex: repro snippet in PR: ```yaml
presets:
  - name: kv-latency-heatmap
    metrics_schema: 'v1'
    tracehook:
      trace_key: null
      span_sampling: true
    blocks:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: latency_p95
```
ruhi: converter currently strips nulls. For trace_key we need to preserve field as empty string in v2. Also span_sampling now expects an object not a boolean.
dave: and I noticed the examples still reference the old playground URL which 404s. We should point to the canonical console link and file an infra redirect.
infra-bot: Suggest replacement: https://console.redwood.ai/playground. Created ticket REDW-2002 for redirect.
alex: propose v2 snippet in PR: ```yaml
presets:
  - name: kv-latency-heatmap
    metrics_schema: 'v2'
    tracehook:
      trace_key: ""
      span_sampling:
        strategy: probabilistic
        rate: 0.01
    blocks:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: latency.p95
        cost_mode: normalized
```
ruhi: looks good. also flagging SDK embed snippets: old field `cost_per_token` -> new `unit_cost.tokens`. I'll sweep those in a follow-up.
dave: please add a checklist to the PR to run the examples smoke test manually before merging.
alex: done, checklist includes local render + smoke tests. CI re-run queued.
ci-bot: CI re-run triggered by @alex.
dave: left a small docs nit on the migration note wording.
ruhi: fixed wording and pushed.
ci-bot: CI passed for examples.
alex: merged. follow-ups: REDW-2003 sweep SDK samples for cost field rename, REDW-2002 infra redirect. thanks all :)
